findings.reason: the false census is the whole justification for the carve-out sentence beside it ("Records without the mark keep their coverage, so those 121 are untouched"), so as written it silently sweeps the one content review whose absent item is this section's own defect instance into a carve-out argued only for the design backfill; a node reproducing the count gets 122 of 1,395 and cannot reconcile the plan's figures.
findings.text: the deliverable's census ("on 2026-10-22, 121 of 1,388 stored plan reviews list an absent item. Every one of the 121 is a design review across 51 plans, missing only `interface_budget`") is false, and its own Why paragraph is the counterexample: measured at this revision, `docs/state/reckon/reviews/plan/**/*.json` holds 1,395 stored plan reviews, 122 with a non-empty `absent_items` — 121 design reviews missing `interface_budget` (51 plans, that half is right) plus `docs/state/reckon/reviews/plan/budget-fits-a-worker-window/r-20261021T004350639605-plan-review-of-budget-fits-a-worker-window.json`, a `content` review recorded `ready` with `absent_items: ['anchors_resolve']`, which is the very record §40's Why cites

findings.reason: a delivered report whose every line is written as a Markdown bullet (the style this section exists to read) is refused outright at the store as "not a review", so the section's stated goal is met on its own test and unmet on the real path; the plan needs `report_carries_review_lines` named in the deliverable or in the new test, and its omission is discoverable only by a node that happens to write an all-bulleted fixture.
findings.text: the deliverable scopes the marker-stripping to the parser, "The plan-review report parser, `parse_review_report`", but the delivery path reaches its admission guard first: `report_carries_review_lines` (`reckon/crew/plan_review.py:2053`) matches the same two anchored patterns at :2063-:2064 over the same `_review_text_lines`, and `delivered_report_record` raises "carries no RUBRIC or FINDING line, so it is not a review" at :2093 before the parser runs

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — resolved against the tree: `_PLAN_RUBRIC_LINE_RE` at `reckon/crew/review.py:1249`, `_PLAN_FINDING_LINE_RE` at :1252, the health-grammar readers at :1443 and :1585; `DEFAULT_STATUS` at `reckon/crew/plan_review.py:211`, the delivered record built at :2100-:2113, `review_coverage` at :797; `require_plan_reviewed` at `reckon/crew/routing.py:2489`. `parse_review_report` resolves as the public alias at `reckon/crew/plan_review.py:78` of `reckon/crew/review.py:parse_plan_review_report`; the file the change is actually made in is the one the section names.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — each of the four bullets is measurable, and the two halves carry one negative control each (restore the anchored pattern → the bulleted finding is dropped; let `review_coverage` count an `incomplete` review → the absent-item plan reads as covered and the dispatch is admitted).
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — gate arms and logs are named to the run directory and the plan's own report root, and the durable fragment lands under `docs/evidence/fragments/a-plan-is-reviewed-before-it-is-built/`; nothing rests on a session scratchpad or `/tmp`.
rubric_items.naming: pass — no plan labels, stage names, ticket numbers or version tags reach the new status value, symbol or test filename; the new marker is named for what it means (`incomplete`).
rubric_items.reasoning: findings — the census is wrong, and the change is scoped to one of the two readers of the anchored patterns on the delivery path.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — the two halves are two code changes, but they serve one verdict (a delivered review is read whole and counted only when whole), each now carries its own assertion and its own negative control, and this pairing was raised and declined earlier; the plan has not changed what it describes.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — §40 declares no `depends-on` and needs none: its write paths (`reckon/crew/review.py`, `reckon/crew/plan_review.py`, the new test, the evidence fragment) collide with no sibling section, and it explicitly hands the receipt-naming half to §37's field rather than declaring a dependency on it.
